memmap2 0.5 is pinned through tract in the development-only Clean Voice helper; the helper remains excluded from release packages
the affected tract parser is confined to the development-only Clean Voice helper, which release packaging excludes
anymap2 is unmaintained, not vulnerable; it is pinned through tract-linalg in the development-only Clean Voice helper, which release packaging excludes

zvariant is unmaintained, not vulnerable (the notice lists no patched version and no CVE); it was merged into zbus 6, but the newest ashpd (0.13.13, 2026-07-17) still requires zbus 5, which pulls the standalone crate, so no update exists. It only serialises D-Bus messages in the Linux capture helper's portal calls, and zbus is mid-migration upstream (z-galaxy/zbus#2043). Revisit when ashpd moves to zbus 6.

zbus_names is unmaintained, not vulnerable; merged into zbus 6 like zvariant (RUSTSEC-2026-0370), and the newest ashpd still requires zbus 5. It only validates D-Bus bus and interface names in the Linux capture helper. Revisit when ashpd moves to zbus 6.
zvariant_derive is unmaintained, not vulnerable; it is the derive macro for zvariant (RUSTSEC-2026-0370) and leaves with it when ashpd moves to zbus 6. It runs at build time only.

rustls-pemfile is unmaintained, not vulnerable. It is pinned by rustls-native-certs 0.7 inside the vendored ureq 2.12.1 (the final 2.x), which sherpa-onnx-sys uses only at build time to download prebuilt libraries. Moving to rustls-native-certs 0.8 means patching vendored third-party code for a build-time-only path, so it waits for a ureq upgrade.
